title: Cancelling the confirmation changes nothing
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANCEL-01) is tracked at {Location-A} and is active.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANCEL-02) is tracked at {Location-A} and is active.
  • {Part-A} and {Part-B} share the start of their numbers (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANCEL-0), so one search lists them together.
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab search the shared start (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANCEL-0), turn on "Deactivate parts", tick both parts and click "Deactivate".
  2. Click "Cancel" in the confirmation, then × on the bulk bar.
  3. Open {Part-A}, pick "Inactive", click Save, then click "Cancel" in the confirmation.
  4. Click Cancel in the part dialog.
  5. Open {Part-A}'s and {Part-B}'s Part History.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Both parts are still on the Active tab.
  • Step 3: The confirmation closes and the part dialog is back with "Inactive" still picked and the pill still "Active".
  • Step 4: {Part-A} is still on the Active tab.
  • Step 5: Neither part has a "Deactivated" entry.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S10-N1, S13-R23, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 3.3 and 4.4, 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-N1: “If the user cancels the confirmation, no part changes status.”
  • S13-R23: “Cancelling the confirmation saves nothing and returns to the dialog with the picked status kept.”
